subject: Re: Fictional Standard Visitor worksheet
text:
Hello — I’m the AI preparation assistant for visa@boshen.dev. I can explain official UK visitor guidance and help organise your own answers. I’m not a regulated immigration adviser and can’t guarantee a visa. Please don’t email passport scans, bank statements, passwords or payment details.

I can organise the words you already chose for an ordinary visitor worksheet. I am not deciding that a visitor application is the right route, and I am not saying the facts meet the rules.

I will not decide visa, ETA, or neither. The official checker is https://www.gov.uk/check-uk-visa.

AI-generated general explanation of the published pages. It is not about you personally:
The published snapshot lists a Standard Visitor fee of £135 for up to 6 months. This is general information from the official pages, not a decision about any person.

Published snapshot accessed 2026-11-08 (Asia/Shanghai). Recheck the official pages before you pay or book. These figures are not a personal fee quote and they are not permanent rules.
If the official checker says a Standard Visitor visa is required, the published fee for up to 6 months was £135. Long-term visitor fees on that page were £506 / £903 / £1128 for 2 / 5 / 10 years, normally up to 6 months per visit.
The published ETA fee was £20 per person, including children. An ETA is not a visa and does not guarantee entry. Usual ETA timing: usually within a day; allow up to 3 working days. It lasts 2 years or until the passport expires, whichever is sooner.
Usual Standard Visitor decision time on the official pages: 3 weeks after identity and the required documents, not after this email. Family route times outside the UK were listed as 12 weeks. Delays and extra fees are possible. Nothing here promises a date or a refund.

Standard Visitor overview: https://www.gov.uk/standard-visitor. Apply page, only if you decide to apply yourself: https://www.gov.uk/standard-visitor/apply-standard-visitor-visa. Checker: https://www.gov.uk/check-uk-visa.

I prepared a local worksheet that repeats what you wrote and leaves blanks. It does not say you meet the visitor rules, and it is not a cover letter to file. Each person needs their own official application, fee, and appointment.

The visitor rules require sufficient funds for reasonable costs. The supporting-documents guide I read did not state a universal minimum bank balance or a universal six-month statement. I will not invent one. It does talk about showing access to funds and where the funds came from. Hotel and flight bookings are on the “less useful” list except where a transit rule asks for an onward journey. The processing page says not to book travel until there is a decision.
Documents that are not in English or Welsh need a full translation that can be independently verified, with the translator's confirmation of accuracy, the date, their full name and signature, and contact details. An AI translation draft is not that confirmation.
The Standard Visitor apply page says the passport or travel document is returned on the same day of the VAC appointment, and a successful applicant gets an eVisa accessed through a UKVI account, usually immediately and possibly up to 24 hours.
The general outside-UK processing page says that if you attended a VAC and left your passport, you should not return to the VAC until you have been contacted.
These statements conflict for an individual VAC. This demo does not choose between them. Escalate, and follow the instructions on the applicant's own UKVI or VAC message. Never ask for a passport to be posted to this inbox.

Ordinary email is not end-to-end encrypted. Nationality and immigration-status details stay in the local case file. They are not sent to DeepSeek in this demo.
Demo files use a product TTL of the configured number of days, or sooner if you ask. That is not a promise about regulated client files or about a provider’s copies. Snapshot 2026-11-08.
Nothing has been submitted, paid, or declared. Auto-reply is off. This message is a draft for review.
